verdict.rationale: Composio explicitly hosts a shared MCP server at https://connect.composio.dev/mcp that any MCP-compatible client can point at directly to reach 1000+ downstream apps without deploying infrastructure, and also supports creating per-session hosted MCP URLs via mcp:true with no server deployment required. This is documented clearly with concrete URLs and setup steps, though there's a community report of a connection failure for one specific integration (Instagram), which is a minor edge case rather than a systemic failure of the hosted-server model. Missing for 10: independent third-party verification of uptime/reliability at scale beyond the single anecdotal failure report.
